question: Can you provide the total number of sessions for each traffic channel in December 2020, using the information from the 'event_params'

WITH params AS (
  SELECT 
    t.event_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING) END) AS ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'source' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS source,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS medium
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_202012*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.event_params) AS ep
  WHERE t.event_date >= '20201201' AND t.event_date <= '20201231'
    AND ep.key IN ('source', 'medium', 'ga_session_id')
  GROUP BY t.event_date, t.event_timestamp, t.event_name, t.event_bundle_sequence_id
),
session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    source,
    medium,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN source IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'(.*shop|shopping.*)') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'(alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart)') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)')
           OR medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN medium = 'email' OR source IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*push') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'mobile') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'(.*video.*)') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'(alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart)') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM params
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) AS total_sessions
FROM session_data
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC
